channel: American Senior Home Guide with Martha
description:
Hi, my name is Martha Bennett. American Senior Home Guide helps older Americans keep their homes safer, more affordable, comfortable, and easier to manage.

My videos cover senior home safety, aging in place, money-saving tips, home maintenance, simple repairs, cleaning, decluttering, organization, gardening, utility bills, home security, seasonal preparation, contractor advice, and ways to prevent costly household problems.

Whether you are living independently after 70, helping aging parents, maintaining an older home, reducing monthly expenses, improving bathroom and kitchen safety, or creating a low-maintenance yard, this channel provides clear and practical guidance.

No politics. No complicated renovations. No unnecessary spending.

Just useful home tips for seniors, older homeowners, retirees, caregivers, and families who want to protect independence and make everyday life at home safer and simpler.
